name: Voter ID / Electoral Roll Enrolment (Form 6)
description: Registration of names in the electoral roll and issuance of Electors Photo Identity Card (EPIC / Voter ID) by the Election Commission of India.
eligibility: Indian citizen, 18+ years on qualifying date, ordinary resident of the constituency.
benefits: Right to vote in elections; EPIC serves as identity and address proof.
application_mode: Online (NVSP / Voter Helpline app) and offline (BLO/ERO)
application_steps: Visit nvsp.in or voterportal.eci.gov.in and register/login.
Fill Form 6 (new enrolment) with details and upload documents.
BLO verifies at residence; name added to draft roll.
processing_time: Typically 2-4 weeks after verification; before each summary revision.
validity: Until deletion on account of death, shift, or disqualification.
office_locator_info: District Electoral Officer / ERO offices; locate via NVSP.

faq.a: Yes, under Form 6A if aged 18+ and not enrolled in India.

faq.q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for voter enrolment?
faq.a: No, Aadhaar is voluntary for identity; other documents are accepted.

ai_summary: ECI issues Voter ID (EPIC) to citizens 18+ via Form 6; free, online through NVSP.
ai_explanation: Any Indian citizen aged 18 can enrol in the electoral roll using Form 6 on NVSP. After BLO verification the name is added and an e-EPIC can be downloaded. The Voter ID also works as ID/address proof.
